SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (M05 Part 2, D32 non-tech case): an invented airline; every figure is made up.

Commitments

As of December 31, 2025, we had firm commitments to purchase 112 aircraft, with aggregate purchase commitments of approximately $14.6 billion, including amounts that we have the right to defer.

As of December 31, 2025, we also had fuel purchase commitments of $1.2 billion.
